label: Past Simple
outcome: Lo studente racconta e riconosce eventi conclusi nel passato usando forme affermative, negative e interrogative corrette, senza mantenere il verbo al passato dopo did o didn't.
must_master: finished actions and situations in a finished past time
regular affirmative forms and core spelling patterns
a small set of high-frequency irregular past forms in context
did questions with the base verb
didn't negatives with the base verb
common finished-past time expressions such as yesterday, last week, two days ago and in 2024
was/were in common school-level past descriptions, questions and negatives

scope_boundary.irregular_verbs: Use only a small high-frequency set needed for natural Past Simple contexts. Systematic retrieval of larger irregular-verb sets belongs to the next Wave 1 topic: irregular-verbs.
scope_boundary.was_were: Include as school-relevant Past Simple support, but do not let be replace the main objective of regular/irregular lexical verbs plus did/didn't.
scope_boundary.later_tenses: Do not contrast with Present Perfect or Past Continuous here; each has its own Recovery topic.

regular_spelling: selected short stressed CVC verbs: double final consonant + ed (stop → stopped)

italian_learner_risks.risk: keeping the past form after did
keeping the past form after didn't
using do/does instead of did for a finished past question
confusing was/were with did in lexical-verb questions
missing the finished-time meaning and selecting a present tense

context_bank: a weekend trip or day out
a missed bus or transport problem
a short message explaining why someone was late
a school event or class activity that finished
a simple sequence of two or three completed events
a past location or state using was/were
questions about a finished weekend or holiday

requirements: teach finished-past meaning before form tables
contrast affirmative past forms with did/didn't + base verb
include regular spelling without turning the lesson into spelling-only practice
include a small high-frequency irregular set in context
include a brief was/were school-support section
five scaffolded graded checks after teaching
include at least one question and one negative
include at least one short contextual production item
mix affirmative, negative and interrogative forms
include regular and high-frequency irregular verbs
include a connected mini-text or event sequence
cover at least one high-frequency irregular form

quality_rejections: a page dominated by a long irregular-verb list
more than two consecutive decontextualised verb-form questions
questions where did is followed by a past form in the answer key
a Past Simple lesson that silently teaches Present Perfect or Past Continuous contrast
ambiguous time reference that does not clearly describe a finished past context
mechanical conversion-only worksheets with no meaningful context
translations with an unnecessarily narrow accepted-answer set
